title: Honest Inference for Transported Complier Effects with Few Informative Target Observations
banked_reason: D0.5.G: tier=incremental below field floor; paper_score_ceiling=6.1<7.4 and salvageable=false. Math panel PASS; oracle-source target-count result is sound but too narrow for field tier.
gap_reasons: this reduction removes source estimation and leaves a narrow composition-only benchmark
the general-class converse assumes asymptotic liminf honesty, and the exact finite-to-Poisson result applies only to the constructed three-cell lower subexperiment
count-tail truncation alone does not compute the minimax constant or an implementable optimal rule
proof_attempt_summary: D0 proved the oracle-source target-count length frontier for every T>0 under the Chen-Huang identifying restrictions, plus a two-sided finite/marked-Poisson randomized minimax transfer and count-kernel program for every lambda>0. D0.5 math passed after direct Maurer-Pontil source verification, but the general review graded the contribution incremental and unsalvageable at the field floor. The proposed universal point-mass-integrality lift is false for small lambda by a zero-count randomization gap; the graph still lists that question as open because the terminal halt preceded a cleanup proof. The related-work positioning finding is editorial and also remains open.
tldr: With source first-stage and compliance-weighted outcome contrasts oracle-given, the Chen--Huang cellwise reduced-form restriction and target-weighted aggregate first-stage restriction suffice for finite-sample honest inference. Unknown target composition forces and permits expected length of order \(\min\{2,T^{-1/2}\}\) for every \(T=N\rho>0\): bounded length is the no-information branch and root-\(T\) contraction is the informative branch. The legal binary-outcome subexperiment has an exact two-sided randomized marked-Poisson minimax limit whenever \(T\to\lambda>0\), while regular Wald intervals are non-uniform.
gap: Regular transported-CACE theory does not isolate uncertainty from a rare target complier count, and the catalogued weak-source frontier does not show that this obstruction survives oracle source knowledge.
fill: The project proves global coverage, a matching target-only length frontier, the marked Poisson boundary, and Wald non-uniformity.
